items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: recorded for the first time as a special favor for Rolf Wall and all the other members of his band back home in Sweden

ctx.x: . . . . . . . Oh Oh Oh Oh Oh Oh Oh Oh Oh

I'm tired of walking dusty highways, tired of having some old boxcores for my home. Oh yes, yes. I said I'm tired of walking dusty highways, tired of having some old boxcores for my home. Yes, I'm tired of being without someone to love. I'm tired of being so blue and all alone. That's why I'm waiting in the darkness to let Southbound afraid the rattler comes along.
